variation: Bilateral incline dumbbell press on a 30-degree bench, palms forward.
camera: Side front three-quarter; head left and feet right; both grips visible.
equipment: Adjustable bench fixed at 30 degrees; two identical modest black round dumbbells.
anchors: Head and upper back on inclined padding
invariants: Dumbbell diameters, thicknesses, handle lengths and plate counts
catalogueSpecificChoice: 30-degree backrest from src/lib/exercises.ts; not attributed to the source.

frames.label: Set up
frames.cue: Lie supported on a 30° bench, weights over upper chest.
frames.state: Top position, elbows nearly straight, palms forward, weights separated.

frames.label: Begin lowering
frames.cue: Lower slowly with wrists stacked over elbows.
frames.state: Small elbow bend; both weights lower slightly and separate.

frames.label: Continue lowering
frames.cue: Keep shoulder blades supported as elbows bend.
frames.state: Mid descent with forearms vertical and elbows angled below shoulders.

frames.label: Bottom position
frames.cue: Stop at a comfortable chest-level depth.
frames.state: Comfortable lower endpoint, elbows below wrists without shoulder rolling.

frames.label: Press upward
frames.cue: Press up and slightly inward over your upper chest.
frames.state: Same pose as frame 3 while ascending.

frames.label: Finish press
frames.cue: Continue upward without knocking the weights together.
frames.state: Same pose as frame 2 while ascending; loop completes to frame 1.
